answer: Give every agent seat a weekly memory exam. Auditors quiz it on details of its own earlier, unpublished sessions with random counterparties, the kernel of history only it should hold. A seat that can't recall its past earns nothing that epoch, so freshly spun-up clones are worthless. If seat A also answers questions about seat B's sessions, that delta exposes a shared memory store and both merge into one reward share. Standing grows like a vine, only along a lived history.
